contract.source_of_truth: Use only the selected_sources below. Do not add or repair any other packet entry.
contract.edit_mode: Additive only. Insert one literature-boundary section before Reproducibility and safety and add matching bibitems before end{thebibliography}. Preserve every original line byte-for-byte and in order.
contract.claims: Association-not-causal, real-data-only. Literature may sharpen limitations or motivate future observables; it may not become a measurement of these SDSS targets.
contract.receipts: For every packet source not selected, add a skipped_sources row. Use a special mismatch reason where listed; otherwise use not selected after round-1 verification: redundant, lower priority, or unnecessary for minimal integration. Validate every citation key is defined and original-line subsequence is exact.

safe_points: Radio luminosity functions and kinetic-power conversions are future mechanical-heating context, not a measurement of this optical denominator.
Multi-epoch radio/X-ray structures show that a present optical line state need not represent integrated jet history.
Cavity power needs radio plus X-ray morphology; it cannot be inferred from this SDSS fibre sample.

safe_points: An optical ionized-gas census is tracer- and definition-dependent and cannot recover neutral/molecular mass loading.
Radio detection can change observed ionized-outflow incidence, motivating radio follow-up without changing this optical prevalence.
Beam smearing and unresolved rotation block galaxy-wide outflow claims from a single aperture.

safe_points: Optical dust/emission proxies can organize follow-up but retain substantial scatter and cannot replace direct cold-gas masses.
Gas fraction and star-formation efficiency can both decline away from the main sequence, so an H-alpha deficit does not isolate either mechanism.
Do not turn either source into a molecular-gas measurement for these SDSS targets.

safe_points: Simulation validation requires mock-observer forward modelling through this exact optical selection; raw intrinsic simulated values are not like-for-like.
Large-volume and calibrated hydrodynamical suites motivate future validation but do not become measurements of the SDSS cells.
The 15-cell optical vector remains selection-conditional and cannot uniquely identify a feedback mechanism.
